title: Cambridge Hospital Al Khobar
hero.text: An advanced rehabilitation and long-term care & hospital

text: Cambridge Hospital Al Khobar is a specialised long-term care and rehabilitation hospital equipped to manage complex cases, including those requiring intensive care. The hospital combines advanced clinical capabilities with structured rehabilitation programmes, supporting patients from critical care through recovery and towards improved functional independence.

The hospital delivers integrated care through a multidisciplinary approach, supported by advanced diagnostic services and purpose-built clinical facilities. With a focus on continuity of care, patient safety and measurable outcomes, Cambridge Hospital Al Khobar plays an important role in providing specialised care across the Eastern Province.
